question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left midfielder, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing right winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Finally, Claire and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) left midfielder
(B) right back
(C) right winger
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire.
Initial: left midfielder | right back | right winger
1. Bob swaps with Alice: right back | left midfielder | right winger
2. Claire swaps with Bob: right back | right winger | left midfielder
3. Claire swaps with Bob: right back | left midfielder | right winger
Bob is playing left midfielder, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
